S-S1.name: s-initial 8-category profile
S-S1.details: STAGING 87.50% (#1 atom, 6.721x enrichment), THERMAL 0.048x, stable 5/5 sections. 4/4 sub-criteria pass. MONITORING only 2.84% — strongly favors H1.

S-S2.name: s+X compound category determinism
S-S2.details: 6/6 FULL MATCH at 100% purity. sh=MONITORING, ksh=MONITORING, lsh=MONITORING, os=OPERATION, es=STAGING, cs=MARKING. Perfect compound determinism.

S-S3.name: s POSITIVE carryover run analysis
S-S3.details: 2.523x enrichment but only 3 s-s pairs (below 5-pair minimum). Known HIGH risk test.

S-S4.name: s-initial macro-state distribution
S-S4.details: AXM only 35.4% (0.523x, rank #13). FQ 64.6% (3.59x enrichment). s lives in FQ macro-state, not AXM. FL_HAZ 0%. s operates during cycling, unlike AXM-confined c/p.

S-S5.name: s->h junction analysis
S-S5.details: s->h 208 observed (13.16x enrichment). MON+STAGING 53.8%. Cross-token depleted (1.61x). Intra:cross ratio 208:1. All 4 sub-criteria pass.

S-S6.name: CHSH+s compound enrichment
S-S6.details: MONITORING only 1.5% (needed >= 30%). But STAGING 44.1% (8.70x enrichment). s maintains STAGING under CHSH prefix, does not shift to MONITORING like c does.

S-S7.name: sh family compound survey
S-S7.details: 3/4 sub-predictions. P1 PASS (92.9% s->h adjacency), P2 PASS (4 distinct Xsh categories), P3 FAIL (5/10 have MON >= 20%), P4 PASS (73.9% compound-final).

S-S8.name: s-compound order sensitivity
S-S8.details: No testable pairs (so N=3, se N=0, sc N=0). Controls validated (ck/kc order-sensitive). All pairs INCONCLUSIVE due to sparse reversed forms.

S-S9.name: Section gradient
S-S9.details: rho(s, MONITORING)=+0.500 >= +0.35 passes P1. But |rho(s, THERMAL)|=0.800 fails P2 (needed <= 0.50). Best tracker is CONTAINMENT (+0.800), not STAGING or MONITORING.

S-S10.name: Alternative hypothesis discrimination
S-S10.details: H1 'sequence' 3/4, H2 'sift' 2/4, H3 'step' 2/4. D1: NEUTRAL 77.3% (H1 match). D2: R4 2.55x (all match). D3: mean 0.547 (all match). D4: MON 36.0% (none match). H1 is best hypothesis.

S-S11.name: Staging injection
S-S11.details: Only 2/6 positive for STAGING injection (ks +100pp, es +100pp). 0/6 for MONITORING. os, cs, sd show 0pp delta. s is structurally neutral in most compound contexts.

S-S12.name: Compositional convergence
S-S12.details: 6/6 FULL match. sh=MONITORING, ksh=MONITORING, lsh=MONITORING, os=OPERATION, es=STAGING, cs=MARKING. Non-h compounds diversely categorized (OPERATION, STAGING, MARKING). h-junction pulls +100pp toward MONITORING.

hypothesis_scores.H1_sequence: Best — S-S10 3/4, S-S1 STAGING #1, S-S12 non-h compounds not MONITORING-dominant
hypothesis_scores.H2_sift: Rejected — MONITORING only 2.84% standalone, non-h compounds not MONITORING

upgrade_decision: REMAIN PLAUSIBLE — 6/12 meets threshold for 'remain PLAUSIBLE' (5-7 range). Current gloss 'sequence' is best hypothesis (H1 wins S-S10), but compound behavior is complex: sh-family is MONITORING, non-h compounds are each different. The 100% compound determinism (S-S2) is the strongest structural result.
